stops.name: Wazespitze
stops.quote: The valley lies at the foot of the Wazespitze (3,533 metres) - the highest mountain in the Kaunergrat - and offers exciting mountain tours as well as climbing routes of all levels of difficulty.
stops.english: The valley lies at the foot of the Wazespitze (3,533 metres) - the highest mountain in the Kaunergrat - and offers exciting mountain tours as well as climbing routes of all levels of difficulty.

stops.name: glacier nature trail
stops.quote: The glacier nature trail reveals fascinating details about the glacier world and leads from the moraine (around 1850) to the Gepatschferner glacier gate.
stops.english: The glacier nature trail reveals fascinating details about the glacier world and leads from the moraine (around 1850) to the Gepatschferner glacier gate.

stops.name: Gepatschferner glacier gate
stops.quote: The glacier nature trail reveals fascinating details about the glacier world and leads from the moraine (around 1850) to the Gepatschferner glacier gate.
stops.english: The glacier nature trail reveals fascinating details about the glacier world and leads from the moraine (around 1850) to the Gepatschferner glacier gate.

stops.name: Piller Moor nature trail
stops.quote: The family-friendly hike along the largely barrier-free Piller Moor nature trail leads through exciting moorland to the peat cutting, where valuable peat was mined until the 1970s.
stops.english: The family-friendly hike along the largely barrier-free Piller Moor nature trail leads through exciting moorland to the peat cutting, where valuable peat was mined until the 1970s.

stops.name: Nature Park House
stops.quote: Visitors can discover exciting exhibitions in the Nature Park House and experience the diverse nature on guided tours or on their own.
stops.english: Visitors can discover exciting exhibitions in the Nature Park House and experience the diverse nature on guided tours or on their own.

stops.name: 3000 m VERTIKAL
stops.quote: A highlight is the Kaunergrat Nature Park House with its interactive exhibition "3000 m VERTIKAL".
stops.english: A highlight is the Kaunergrat Nature Park House with its interactive exhibition "3000 m VERTIKAL".

stops.name: Kaunertal glacier hike
stops.quote: Themed hiking trails such as the Piller Moor nature trail and the Kaunertal glacier hike are particularly popular.
stops.english: Themed hiking trails such as the Piller Moor nature trail and the Kaunertal glacier hike are particularly popular.

stops.name: upland moor in the Pillertal
stops.quote: The upland moor in the Pillertal, a small side valley of the Pitztal, in the centre of the Kaunergrat Nature Park, has fascinated visitors for thousands of years with its extraordinary flora and fauna.
stops.english: The upland moor in the Pillertal, a small side valley of the Pitztal, in the centre of the Kaunergrat Nature Park, has fascinated visitors for thousands of years with its extraordinary flora and fauna.
